artworks.title: Domestic Scene
artworks.medium: red, black, and white chalk on blue-gray paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John H. Steiner
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. On the left, a child is holding a plant or branch. On the right, an adult is holding a baby. Both figures are depicted in loose, flowing garments. The child is seated, facing slightly right, and the adult is seated, facing slightly left, embracing the baby. The figures have softly sketched facial features and wear long robes. The drawing is done in red and black chalk on a blue-grey background.

artworks.title: Holy Family with Saint Anne and Female Head in Profile
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Elizabeth Miles Cooke in memory of Hereward Lester Cooke
artworks.description: The drawing depicts four figures sitting closely together, with only the upper half of their bodies visible. In the center, a woman is holding a small child on her lap. To the left, another figure is seated, facing inward. On the right, a standing figure looks over the others. All figures are draped in flowing garments. The drawing is executed in a delicate, lined sketch style with minimal detail, set against a plain background.

artworks.title: The Ascension of the Virgin
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Elizabeth Miles Cooke in memory of Hereward Lester Cooke
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures interacting dynamically. The image uses free-flowing ink lines to sketch four figures in movement. The figures appear to be positioned in a swirling, energetic composition, with various gestures indicating motion. The lines are loose and expressive, emphasizing movement and fluidity rather than precise detail, giving the drawing a sense of spontaneity and liveliness. There are various scribbles and dots of ink, which add to the sense of rapid execution.

artworks.title: Holy Family with St. Elizabeth, St. John the Baptist, and Two Angels in a Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with touches of brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Elizabeth Miles Cooke in memory of Hereward Lester Cooke
artworks.description: The image is a line drawing showing five figures: three adults, an angel, and two young children. The adults and children are seated in the foreground. The adults wear flowing garments, and their faces are softly rendered. Two of the adults interact with the children. The children appear youthful and innocent. One adult has a prominent forehead and a beard. An angel hovers above them with faintly sketched wings. The background has minimal details of trees and clouds. There are no visible jewelry or objects except for a small cross held by one of the adults. The artwork focuses on the arrangement of the figures through delicate strokes and cross-hatching, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child with Five Saints
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Elizabeth Miles Cooke in memory of Hereward Lester Cooke
artworks.description: The sketch shows a group of individuals surrounding a central figure of a child sitting on the lap of an adult. The child is depicted facing forward with simple features, while the adult figure is seated and holds the child. Other figures surround them, looking towards the child. The clothing is traditional, with no visible jewelry or objects. The background has minimal details, with cloud-like motifs above the figures. The composition is circular.

artworks.title: Magdalene Washing the Feet of Christ with Eight Disciples Looking On [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Elizabeth Miles Cooke in memory of Hereward Lester Cooke
artworks.description: This is a sketch showing a group of people depicted from approximately the waist up. They appear to be seated closely together, facing each other. The drawing is loose and not highly detailed. The individuals have vague facial features with minimal details, and their hairstyles seem varied but lack specific attributes. The clothing is depicted with simple lines, adding to the antiquated style of the drawing. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or distinct objects they are holding. One figure seems to be in a kneeling posture to the left of the group, head lowered towards the ground. The background is neutral and plain, emphasizing the line work of the figures. The entire composition is rendered in a monochrome style, likely using ink on paper.

artworks.title: Seven Figures Witnessing an Ascension [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Elizabeth Miles Cooke in memory of Hereward Lester Cooke
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various figures gesturing or reaching toward something. The drawing consists of intricate line work depicting a scene filled with movement. Several figures are sketched, some extending their arms as if interacting or gesturing towards an unseen entity or focal point. The figures appear to be in a conversation with their environment, surrounded by architectural elements like columns on the left. The drawing uses lines to outline shapes and forms to suggest depth and continuing action beyond the frame. Light and shading through hatching give volume and texture to the figures, emphasizing their expressions and interactions.

artworks.title: Musician and Dancing Figures
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with touches of brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Elizabeth Miles Cooke in memory of Hereward Lester Cooke
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of human figures in motion. The sketch features outlined figures positioned closely together, engaged in movement. The figures are drawn with flowing lines, conveying a sense of fluidity. There is a central pair surrounded by other figures in the background. The background is blank, emphasizing the detailed figures. The drawing is done in a sepia tone on aged paper, giving it an antique look.

artworks.title: Holy Family [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with touches of brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Elizabeth Miles Cooke in memory of Hereward Lester Cooke
artworks.description: The image shows an ink drawing of three figures, two adults, and one child, seated together. The scene is visually framed within an oval sketch. The person on the left is shown from the waist up, seated, and appears to be holding a child on their lap. Their head is slightly turned to the right. The child is positioned sitting on the lap of the person on the left, facing forward with their head turned slightly to the right, as if gazing toward the second adult figure. The figure on the right is also depicted from the waist up, seated and facing slightly toward the other two figures. All figures are loosely clothed, with flowing garments visible through the sketchy lines. There are no additional objects or visible details of jewelry within the image. The background is minimal with sweeping lines suggesting the presence of a blanket or cushion behind the figures. The overall setting is undefined, focusing primarily on the interaction among the three subjects.

artworks.title: Female Figure (Penitent Magdalene?) [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Elizabeth Miles Cooke in memory of Hereward Lester Cooke
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of an abstract representation of a person's upper body and head. The figure is facing right, with the head slightly tilted forward. The facial features are minimally detailed, with emphasis on the outline rather than specific details, and the hair is indicated with simple lines. The figure seems to be wearing a flowing garment, but clear clothing details are not defined. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the figure. The background consists of the texture of the paper and some faint lines and sketches.

artworks.title: Penitent Magdalene with Angels in a Landscape [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Elizabeth Miles Cooke in memory of Hereward Lester Cooke
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a full-length figure seated outdoors. The individual is positioned on the ground amidst a hilly landscape, leaning slightly back against a rocky formation, with their body turned slightly towards the right. Their facial features are delicately sketched, and they appear contemplative, with gentle eyes and a serene expression. The person's hair is short to medium length, flowing naturally. They are draped in classical robes that flow around their body. Two cherubic figures hover in the air nearby. An open book and a skull rest on the ground beside the seated figure. The background includes softly drawn trees and shrubs.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Elizabeth Miles Cooke in memory of Hereward Lester Cooke
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowded scene with various figures in motion and interaction. The composition is dense with numerous characters sketched in a fluid and dynamic manner. Each figure seems to be engaged with one another. The lines are expressive, suggesting movement and emotion. In the foreground, there is a figure kneeling, extending towards others who are gathered around.

artworks.title: Studies of Figures for an Adoration of the Magi [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with traces of red and black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Elizabeth Miles Cooke in memory of Hereward Lester Cooke
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various figures sketched on a textured background. The drawing shows figures in different poses. On the left, there are outlines depicting beings or figures standing together. In the center, one figure appears crouching or kneeling in a dynamic posture. On the right, there are two figures, one possibly standing and the other crouching or interacting with the floor. The drawing has an unfinished and ethereal quality, with sketchy lines capturing motion and emotion rather than perfect form. The background shows signs of age, with darker stains and discolored patches creating depth in the scene.

artworks.title: Auguste-Jean-Marie Guénepin
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Peter Josten
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the waist up, in a seated or relaxed standing position. The person is holding a book in their left hand. They have a rounded face, defined eyes, and wavy hair styled above their forehead. They are dressed in a coat with a high collar and large buttons. In the background, there is a faint architectural structure resembling a building with columns and windows. The sketch is done in soft pencil, giving it a delicate and unfinished quality.

artworks.title: Isabella Abandons Her Home to Follow Odorico and His Men
artworks.medium: black chalk, stumping, with brown and gray wash  on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edith G. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing with swirling, gestural lines and dramatic figures in a chaotic setting. The background is defined by shaded, dramatic strokes. The artist uses dark lines and sepia tones to evoke drama and tension within the scene.

artworks.title: Angelica Is Exposed to the Orc
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edith G. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features an array of intertwined lines and shapes, creating an abstract composition. Swirling lines in the upper part of the image suggest cloud-like forms or waves. In the lower region, a structured form resembling a boat is visible, with rounded shapes inside. One form appears to be holding a trident or similar implement, adding a mythological or nautical theme to the scene.

artworks.title: Orlando Kills the Orc with an Anchor
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edith G. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ship at sea in stormy conditions. The ship is being tossed by large waves under a cloudy sky. In the upper portion of the drawing, there is an outline of a mythical being or spirit among the clouds. The scene is primarily in shades of brown and black, with sweeping lines conveying movement and chaos. The central figure on the ship seems to be engaged in action, and there are other figures in the background.

artworks.title: Orlando and Angelica Arrive at Charlemagne's Camp
artworks.medium: black chalk, stumping, with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edith G. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person on horseback surrounded by ethereal figures. The composition shows an individual mounted on a rearing horse. The scene is full of movement with swirling clouds and several cherubic figures, some playing musical instruments, seemingly emerging or descending from the sky. The drawing uses light lines creating a sense of motion and fluidity, while the sepia tones lend an antique and classical feel to the overall image.

artworks.title: Bradamante Tries to Catch Hold of the Hippogryph [recto]
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edith G. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of equestrian figures amidst swirling clouds and dynamic lines. The scene is monochromatic with flowing lines and shading. The composition features horses rearing and figures in motion within an atmospheric cloudscape. The style resembles Giovanni Battista Tiepolo's dynamic compositions and expressive linework. The drawing conveys energy, movement, and a sense of action or conflict, typical of Tiepolo's work, with subtle shading and line variations adding depth and complexity.

artworks.title: Man on a Horse [verso]
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edith G. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing a person sitting on a horse. The person is drawn from head to mid-torso, including parts of the horse's outline. The individual is wearing a tricorn hat, with flowing hair and lightly sketched facial features. The person is wearing a coat and holding a long object in their right hand while the left hand is raised. The background is a blank canvas with slight texture.

artworks.title: Half-Figure of an Old Woman with a Cap
artworks.medium: charcoal with green wash added by a later hand on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 39.6 x 23.6 cm (15 9/16 x 9 5/16 in.)
support: 39.6 x 24.9 cm (15 9/16 x 9 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edith G. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image displays the upper half of an elderly woman's body in profile, facing the left side. Her arms rest in front of her, and her facial features are detailed, showing prominent cheekbones, deep-set eyes, and wrinkles. She wears a simple head covering with textured folds and plain clothing, partially exposing her bust. She is not wearing any jewelry or holding objects. The background is a solid, muted blue-green color, providing contrast and focusing attention on the woman.

artworks.title: Lion of the Atlas Mountains (Lion de l'Atlas)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a lion with its prey. The lion is shown with a detailed mane, holding a smaller animal close to its chest. The lion's expression is intense and serene. The background depicts a rugged landscape. The drawing showcases the texture of the lion's fur and details of the environment in a monochromatic tone.

artworks.title: Royal Tiger (Tigre Royal)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a tiger lying on the ground in a natural landscape. The tiger is shown resting on a terrain with foliage and grass. The background includes a mountain range and a sky with clouds. The tiger's stripes are detailed, and the composition presents a calm yet powerful atmosphere.

artworks.title: Pan Reclining
artworks.artist: Sir Peter Paul Rubens after Francesco da Sangallo
artworks.medium: red and black chalk with red wash and gouache on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: Drawn with red and black chalk on cream-colored paper, a satyr has a man’s muscular upper body and the legs of a goat as he lies sprawled on his back across the width of this horizontal sheet. He lies with his head to our right and hooves to our left. His right arm, farther from us, is flung over his head and with that hand, he touches the sheep’s skin on which he reclines. The sheep’s head rests near the satyr’s shoulder. The satyr’s eyes are blank under lowered, deeply furrowed brows. His nose is bumped over the bridge and pointed at the end. His full lips are open to reveal his tongue and lower teeth over a cleft chin. A mustache or goatee is loosely drawn, and hollows in his cheeks suggest high cheekbones. A wine skin, like an oversized hot water bottle, is tucked under the hollow of his lower back. His left arm, closer to us, lies along the side of his body, and he holds a pan flute in that brawny hand. He has the furry haunches of a goat, and his legs are splayed so his hooves reach into the upper and lower left corners of the sheet. A grapevine with a few clusters of fruit curls behind his lower limbs and meanders across the background. Gray washes and sketchy lines are layered behind the vine. A tiny uppercase “R” appears to be penned near the lower right corner. Lower in that corner, a round stamp has a crown over an uppercase “W” above the letters “JCR.”
